text:
Slide 1: Handoff Decision
- Purpose: decide whether service is ready for operational handoff
- Readiness: not ready for acceptance
- Reason: successful rollback rehearsal has not happened

Slide 2: Acceptance Criteria Status
- Requires approved runbook and successful rollback rehearsal
- Current: runbook is approved
- Current: rollback rehearsal has not happened

Slide 3: Ownership During Transition
- Engineering lead Lee owns defect fixes until acceptance
- Operations lead Jo owns incidents only after acceptance
- No role has accepted responsibility for organizing the rehearsal

Slide 4: Actions Required
- Sponsor Pat can assign responsibility for organizing rehearsal
- Complete successful rollback rehearsal
- Sponsor Pat can approve acceptance once criteria are met
